authority.intentionally_uncovered_reason: Architectural invariant: not falsifiable by a data-driven fixture. Enforced by the typed encode(shape, value) API surface and the Phase 1 no-reflection / no-Any self-checks (docs/implementation/phase-01-canonical-encoding.md section 5).
authority.short_statement: Encoding is schema-directed: the encoder is driven by an explicit machine type (Shape) and never reflects over arbitrary host objects.
Canonical bytes are UTF-8 without BOM, contain no insignificant whitespace and have no leading or trailing data; decoders reject all of these.
Machine numerics are encoded as canonical decimal (or float64 hex) text inside JSON strings; JSON numbers are never the canonical authority and are rejected by the decoder.
String content is NFC-normalized: canonically equivalent inputs produce identical canonical bytes, and the decoder rejects non-NFC text.
Map keys are NFC-normalized before use.
Map keys and record members are emitted in unsigned UTF-8 byte lexicographic order; input order never affects canonical bytes.
Duplicate map keys are rejected, including keys that collide only after NFC normalization; never last-write-wins.
float64 is encoded as exactly 16 lowercase IEEE-754 hex characters inside a JSON string (big-endian bit pattern).
NaN and infinities are rejected by both encoder and decoder.
The float64 -0 bit pattern canonicalizes to +0; the decoder rejects the -0 pattern as non-canonical.
bytes are unpadded base64url; padding, the standard alphabet, impossible lengths and non-canonical trailing bits are rejected.
timestamp and duration are nominal int64 microsecond values encoded as canonical int64 text; cross-assignment between them and int64 is rejected.
Option is explicitly tagged: None encodes {"none":null} and Some(v) encodes {"some":v}; the null-sugar encoding and any other member shape are rejected, and any legal type may sit under an option.
Enums and variants are closed: unknown enum values and unknown variant cases are rejected (fail-closed).
Only a complete validator-origin fact roster may derive a full obligation view.
Scope retains complete compiler/context/resolver/root/assertion values and context-role partition.
Source, target, coordinate and declared occurrence origin must be complete and consistent.
References are complete typed evidence coordinates, not RuleIds or prose identities.
Only equal originating facts merge observations; distinct origins stay distinct.
Status, disposition, links, contradiction and observations remain required alongside identity.
The private successor constructor requires proof eligibility and successful complete bounded normalization.
Text, ordering, emptiness or successful serialization cannot create proof or runtime authority.
Every semantic model type has exact closed field, width, option and variant descriptors.
Sets and identity views use the registered typed total order, preserving semantic sequences.
Canonical identity strings are schema-directed ACE1 of the complete identity and decode bijectively.
Full scope is a finite minimal reachable typed value DAG with canonical bottom-up ranks.
Output/work/graph limits fail explicitly without truncated successful reports.
Unknown, missing, duplicate or noncanonical report fields/variants/identities are rejected without repair.
Independent Expected compares every required typed field and canonical byte, not strings alone.
Model identity/rank/derivation changes require new shape/obligation/content edition.
The supported owner binds complete sources, registries, attribution, model and support policy.
Owner@2 admits only its implementation-owned exact current edition without implicit old support.
Admission failures retain canonical/content/identity/support/resource categories, not static Violation.
Legacy code/inputs/Expected and new-edition independent evidence are immutable separate domains.
Registry, support, producers, lossless views and independent conformance activate only as one transaction.
Applied-rule attribution is explicit and does not claim complete dependency closure.
Analysis and canonical_validation retain the actual same context association and exact ordered role partition; equal contents do not prove object identity.
Native prerequisites, typed references, supporting facts and all consumers retain applicability, original stage and origin; observed false containment is not upgraded to Proven.
Native input Scope excludes generated results and witnesses; the independent non-root fragment and separate finite witness DAG cannot grant root CompleteView.
Raw subjects preserve all thirteen parsed Raw fields, real declarative documents and physical byte associations without inventing historical input.
Raw analysis and canonical validation use the actual same nine-member context object and exact partition without a fabricated resolver.
Raw physical bytes, parsed declarations, diagnostic presentation, canonical validation and Checked states remain distinct; parser failure is not a port predicate.
The single positive_unique_io_ports case preserves the actual input-before-output stable numeric sort and reached positivity/uniqueness check before schema resolution.

Zero and duplicate violations retain complete typed U32 occurrences and real predecessor evidence; positive facts have no contradiction and diagnostic strings cannot supply evidence.
Raw prerequisites and typed member references retain original stage and origin, all observations and consumers; one local positive port does not prove namespace coverage.
Future branch-created evidence is borrowed before diagnostic reduction; source, context and evidence lifetimes cannot produce a Checked token or trusted caller assertion.
Raw input Scope excludes generated facts and witnesses, whose separate finite DAGs and non-root fragment cannot convert to CompleteView.
Complete document content, declared occurrence, internal member and output observation are distinct identities; equal content does not imply equal occurrence.
Occurrence admission requires an actual supplied complete SourcePackage and real owner revision and document slot; missing provenance cannot be synthesized from a candidate or invocation.
Exact UTF8 namespace, domain, owner and revision keys establish only declared source identity and never external authentication or global ownership.
Owner anchor and actual U64 document-entry ordinal define occurrence; equal content reuses it and unequal content at the same key fails BindingConflict.
External document slot, internal document path, port original and sorted ordinals and observation site remain separate and all selected input members must agree.
Occurrence binding starts at RawInputOrigin and propagates through subject, source, raw origin, FactKey, basis, witness and references without mixed occurrences.
Equal typed content still interns under the finite minimal reachable DAG; different real occurrence bindings are different typed values and source packages cannot refer to generated outputs.
Only equal complete scoped originating facts with equal non-observation payload union legitimate observations; conflicting payloads fail InvalidFacts and observations never generate occurrences.
The one Raw port predicate, actual execution prefix and nine-member same-object context partition remain unchanged; no context role, resolver or generic schema profile supplies document identity.

Current lookup requires unique full canonical root and complete actual acyclic imported-definition closure; malformed candidate ambiguity rejects before native context assembly.
Current TypeSchemaRef contains actual specification_id, type_name and sha256/type-schema HashV1 of complete canonical root; catalog checksum is not schema identity.
NotReached, Missing, Ambiguous, FamilyMismatch, applicable RevisionMismatch, Found, Invalid and Valid have separate closed typed payloads and actual stage applicability.

Each of effect_resource, recovery_usage and flow_execution has its exact closed native type/family/root association and independent Some/None validation; absent snapshots are not positive relation evidence.

Every new source/result/field/variant and required association has a closed nominal descriptor and executed registration coverage; shape success is not actual lookup or producer conformance.

canonical_constraints: Untrusted assertion descriptors use the deterministic **Raw(T)** companion family: transform each text/string/identifier/digest-spelling scalar position into exact UTF8 bytes, preserving its original nominal field/model tag; keep actual byte fields as bytes, fixed-width native numerics as their exact nominal widths, option tags and actual native enum cases; recursively transform every field/case payload; preserve every Vec as sequence, including bad assertion order. Native set values retain their defined set semantics. Freeze the complete resulting companion descriptors in RM, not a runtime reflection transform. Thus Raw(CompilerClaim),Raw(Context),Raw(binding) retain invalid/NFD compiler labels,paths,pins and names without normalizing them. Checked owner/source subjects use ordinary validated descriptors. Comparing a claimed text scalar to the owner compares exact UTF8 bytes, not raw/checked wrapper tags or normalized text. A truly unknown native model case still fails UnsupportedModel; unknown transport cases fail earlier. This family gives byte-exact claim preservation without an opaque serialized object or a natural-language parser.

Allowed class relation is predicate-specific, not merely clause-wide: static predicates use static_declaration; body/implementation use trusted_body/implementation_attestation; runtime/publisher use authority_attestation/publisher_authentication; Scope authority/budget static_declaration with Unproven; actual owned-child settlement uses control_terminal_state, while static timeout-outcome separation and passive-AWAIT declarations use static_declaration; commit_order uses committed_effect_order; recovery_blocked_outcome uses recovery_outcome; compensation eligibility uses provider_receipt; retry facts distinguish static declarations, provider_honoring and application_idempotency predicates by their actual evidence query. TypedValue={model_type:ModelType,value:CanonicalValueDag}, with exactly one root of that model_type, is a value under a **closed ModelType descriptor**, materialized as the following finite DAG. Its self-contained DAG is finite; it never contains Scope/Fact/Obligation/report as a descendant. ModelType is an exact member of RM's closure, bound to source edition/type name and full descriptor; no arbitrary string creates a new model.

ModelType={owner:SpecificationId,name:Text}: owner is an exact source-pinned imported AFIDL specification or the exact inherited RM@1 or successor RM@2; name must occur in its registered closed descriptor closure. Full descriptors are obtained from the complete owner/source bundle in Scope, not serialized recursively inside each ModelType. ClosedField/ClosedCase are exact text tokens present in that ModelType's approved ordered descriptor. Unknown owner/name/field/case is UnsupportedModel. This is type reference by full supported content, not an unbound local table index or arbitrary model-name string.

NodeBody = scalar:ScalarValue
 | record:Seq<{field:ClosedField,value:DagRank}>
 | variant:{case:ClosedCase,payload:DagRank}
 | sequence:Seq<DagRank> | set:Seq<DagRank>

 | int64:I64 | uint64:U64 | decimal:ExactDecimal | float64:FiniteFloat64
 | string:NfcText | bytes:Bytes | timestamp:MicrosI64 | duration:MicrosI64.
CanonicalValueDag={nodes:Seq<DagNode>,roots:NonemptySeq<DagRank>}.
Node<T> is a typed DagRank whose descriptor is exactly T. Roots are in ScopeSubject field order, duplicates allowed for equal-valued roots. Value nodes cannot contain Fact/Obligation/report/Scope as descendants. Identity's Scope is a complete graph; every used member/evidence node must be reachable from its subject roots. Object graphs that need extra evidence values add them as declared input roots in their registered subject, never as final-report roots.

Validate acyclicity, widths/descriptors and semantic sets first. Intern equal typed values bottom-up (no hash-only equality); node height0 for scalars/empty containers, otherwise1+maximum child height. Sort each height by descriptor type identity then nonrecursive payload and ordered child ranks, assign contiguous ranks starting0; child ranks strictly smaller. Sets sort by their domain's typed key/full payload; sequence order is preserved. Require no duplicates,unreachable nodes,alternate node numbering or redundant equal nodes at decode. A duplicated equal subtree and shared subtree yield the same minimal DAG. No recursion through final report or digest fixed point exists.

Identity order is scope,assertion_path,stage,derived role,dimension,kind,source,source_ordinal,mapping_ordinal,target,coordinate,rule,requirement,origin. Source/Target/Coordinate/Evidence/contradiction/observation variants use declaration ranks; other records field order above; Requirement clauses use kind-family rank then listed clause order. Rule order=(specification_id,rule_id,anchor). Scalar types are nominal; mathematical numeric comparison, exact rational Decimal, finite float after frozen zero canonicalization, bool false<true, unsigned UTF8/bytes, None<Some, lexicographic tuple/sequence prefix first. Map/set compare sorted complete logical values; DAG ranks are canonical representation, **not a shortcut for semantic numeric order**. Comparisons memoize typed node pairs and charge work.
